title: Why sovereign AI is the next trillion dollar opportunity

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your data never left your country again?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Governments are racing to control AI power — and the stakes are huge.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Sovereign AI is AI that’s built, trained, and owned entirely within one nation.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses quantum-secure encryption to keep data safe from foreign access.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects every industry — from healthcare to defense — by keeping info local.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: Control over AI equals control over the future.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how your country is preparing for this shift?

caption_text: Why sovereign AI is the next trillion dollar opportunity
